evidence: 45,005 of 122,507 domestic-league rows have same_country=0 although an independent computation gives 4,815 legitimate zeros; cause: country parsed from 'CLUB:XXX:' ids only
impact_on_training: A corrupted feature (37.6% of rows) would be learned as a spurious signal and would not be reproducible at inference
recommended_corrective_action: Drop the column or recompute it from a country field; regenerate the dataset as v1.1

evidence: Russian Premier League 2019-20 duplicated: europe/russia/2019-20_ru2.txt (titled '1. Division') contains the same 240 fixtures as ru1; 460 rows in the extended set (_evidence/duplicate_fixtures_all_results_same_date_pair_score.csv)
impact_on_training: Elo and form of Russian clubs double-updated; duplicate fixtures in the training split
recommended_corrective_action: Exclude the mislabelled ru2 2019-20 file; add a cross-competition (date, team pair, score) duplicate check to the build

evidence: Scores include extra time and no regulation-time column exists; 688 shoot-out matches; knockout stage not recorded
impact_on_training: A 90-minute 1X2 label cannot be verified for tournament knockouts; labels would mix extra-time results
recommended_corrective_action: Add stage / regulation score from a permitted source or restrict to matches that cannot have extra time; until then do not train a 90-minute model

evidence: Player match data is a patchwork of selected competition-seasons (66 competition-seasons with >=5 prior rows, 2015-16 and 2023-24 dominate), no lineups / injuries / context
impact_on_training: A performance regression would measure data availability, not skill; chronological split impossible within a competition
recommended_corrective_action: Do not train player-performance prediction on this data; seek continuous data first

evidence: Strict knockout draw rate 30.7% vs 19.6% for all knockout results; strict knockouts are 2,287 rows (1.8%)
impact_on_training: Selection on the target: cup / continental models trained on the strict set are biased towards draws
recommended_corrective_action: Use league-only for the first model; for cups obtain verified 90-minute scores for plain-score knockouts

evidence: 3,971 extra rows depend on an inference ('no a.e.t./pen. marker => decided in 90 minutes'); verified against raw lines (0 violations) but still an inference
impact_on_training: Some labels may be wrong if a source omitted a marker
recommended_corrective_action: Keep extended out of the primary model; use it only for sensitivity analysis

evidence: 64 disconnected rating components; 38,234 extended rows (29.4%) in isolated components (Brazil, MLS, Liga MX, Nigeria, Argentina, Japan, China...)
impact_on_training: Elo values are not comparable across components; a pooled model would misread them
recommended_corrective_action: Model per component / league, or add league-strength features and exclude isolated leagues from the pooled model

evidence: 3,313 of 4,969 entities and 34.6% of match sides are unresolved; 310 same-name groups with several ids; 80 possible split-club candidates
impact_on_training: Continental / cup histories of split clubs are incomplete; cup and continental training rows are dropped
recommended_corrective_action: Review the candidate lists manually; extend alias coverage outside Europe (no automatic merging)

evidence: 706 openfootball rows have a season label inconsistent with their dates (e.g. Nigerian second tier file labelled 2017-18 with dates in 2018-09; 157 strict rows) (_evidence/season_label_date_inconsistent_openfootball.csv)
impact_on_training: Season-based splits / season features would misplace these rows
recommended_corrective_action: Derive the season from the date window or correct labels; re-check file titles

evidence: 1,571 extended rows (1.21%) are CC BY-SA 4.0; no NOTICE file ships with the training CSV; share-alike scope of derived features / models unresolved
impact_on_training: Redistribution of the dataset or a model trained on it may carry share-alike obligations
recommended_corrective_action: Legal review; ship an attribution notice; keep Wikipedia rows flaggable (column source_license) and exclude them from a CC0-only release

evidence: StatsBomb LICENSE.pdf was not machine-readable; README allows research / analysis with credit; ML-training permission is not explicit
impact_on_training: Player clustering / models may exceed the licence if used commercially
recommended_corrective_action: Read the PDF, obtain written clarification; restrict to research use meanwhile

evidence: Scottish Premiership, Segunda, 2. Bundesliga, 3. Liga, Ligue 2, Turkish, Belgian, Greek, Austrian 2. Liga and English L1/L2/NL stop between 2025-11 and 2026-03 in the dated source; 04e (1,162 undated results) cannot be used chronologically; Belgian 2026-27 has 305 dated fixtures without results
impact_on_training: Forward-holdout contains only early-season matches for these leagues - biased sample; results are unrecoverable from permitted dated sources
recommended_corrective_action: Exclude these league-seasons from evaluation or obtain a dated feed; do not use 04e for chronological features

evidence: 812 rows have no pass/shot/tackle; in addition ~0.2% of rows (players with no recorded event) have passes / shots / tackles forced to 0 while goals, xG and other metrics are NaN (see file 09)
impact_on_training: Mixed missing-as-zero conventions bias per-90 features for cameo players
recommended_corrective_action: Set all metrics NaN for players with no event record; keep minutes

evidence: StatsBomb windows are 'last N observed matches': 30.6% of complete 5-match windows span >60 days; 16.8% of previous-match gaps exceed 21 days
impact_on_training: Windows are not real recent form
recommended_corrective_action: Use span / gap columns as filters; do not present as 'last N matches'

evidence: openfootball players use team-scoped name keys: 584 names under several keys, 873 names in both sources; nationality missing for 100% and position for 100% of lineup players
impact_on_training: Transfers unlinkable; no position-specific analysis for openfootball players
recommended_corrective_action: Obtain a licensed player id source; keep sources separate

evidence: About 40% of extended rows have no kick-off time; same-day ordering cannot be proven (506 entity-days with two or more eligible matches)
impact_on_training: Handled conservatively (date batches), but strict 'known before kick-off' proof is impossible
recommended_corrective_action: Keep date-level cut-off; mark per-kickoff leakage checks UNVERIFIED

evidence: Constant 0; neutral venues (finals) unmarked, home advantage applied
impact_on_training: No information; cup / continental finals mis-modelled
recommended_corrective_action: Drop until neutral-venue data is added

evidence: Elo / form state is updated with 'inferred_no_marker' results (7,873 openfootball + others), so strict-set features rest on inferred results
impact_on_training: Not leakage, but the 'verified-only' guarantee does not extend to features
recommended_corrective_action: Document; optionally rebuild state from confirmed labels only for a sensitivity run

evidence: 41 of 589 finished competition-seasons with an expected count show an unexplained shortfall (total 143 matches; mostly EFL Cup, Coupe de France, lower cups); expectations for lower leagues rely on source-declared schedules (evidence grade B/C) and cannot reveal matches absent from the schedule
impact_on_training: Cup completeness is not independently provable
recommended_corrective_action: Treat cups as descriptive; confirm against an official fixture list

evidence: Expected total 197 is derived from the Wikipedia box count (COVID format with two single-leg round-of-16 ties); structure is consistent (14 R16, 4 QF, 2 SF, 1 F) but not externally confirmed
impact_on_training: Minor
recommended_corrective_action: Keep evidence grade low

evidence: 8 fills replace unscored openfootball rows; 4 of them carry a date one day later than the openfootball placeholder (2025-12-02 vs 2025-12-03)
impact_on_training: One-day date uncertainty for 4 matches
recommended_corrective_action: Prefer the Wikipedia date, flag as disagreement (already marked status_differs in cross_validation_pairs.csv)
